source_refs.note: Roman Urdu solutions of the Chapter 6 exercise (PDF 171-174; answer key PDF 226).

blocks.text: Exercise mein 18 MCQs, 9 short questions aur 8 long questions hain, aur sab ka hal yahan diya gaya hai. MCQ ka sahi jawab chapter ke text ke mutabiq hai; kitab ki answer key (Unit 6) sirf pehle 10 MCQs ke jawab deti hai, aur jahan woh mukhtalif hai wahan 'Kitab ki ghalti' box hai. Pehle khud hal karein, phir jawab dekhein.

blocks.prompt:
1. What is the main benefit of edge computing?
Edge computing ka main faida kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Edge computing data ko door ke data center ki bajaye us ke source ke qareeb process karti hai, is liye data kam safar karta hai aur latency (der) kam hoti hai, aur kaam foran (real time) hota hai (6.6.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
2. Which cloud deployment model is characterized by resources being shared among multiple organizations with common concerns?
Kaunse deployment model mein resources aise kai organizations mein share hote hain jin ke concerns (zarooratein aur maqsad) ek jaise hon?
blocks.explanation: (Chapter se aage.) Community cloud aise kai organizations mil kar istemal karte hain jin ki zarooratein ek jaisi hon, jaise ek jaisi security chahne wale hospitals ya sarkari mahkame. Public cloud har kisi ke liye, private cloud ek organization ke liye aur hybrid cloud public aur private ka mel hai (6.2.3).

blocks.prompt:
3. In what way does a private cloud differ from a public cloud?
Private cloud public cloud se kis tarah alag hai?

options.text: Private cloud kai organizations ki milkiyat aur istemal mein hoti hai
Private cloud data aur resources par kam control deti hai
Private cloud sirf ek organization ke liye hoti hai aur data aur security par zyada control deti hai
Private cloud public se sasti aur kam mehfooz hai

blocks.explanation: Private cloud sirf ek organization istemal karti hai aur share nahi hoti (6.2.3.2), is liye zyada control aur security deti hai, jaise bank ka naazuk (sensitive) customer data. Public cloud share hoti hai, sasti aur kam mehfooz (6.2.4).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 6) (b) deti hai. Magar private cloud kam nahi balke zyada control deti hai, kyunke sirf ek organization use istemal karti hai (6.2.3.2, 6.2.4); sahi jawab (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. What is a key advantage of using a distributed ledger in blockchain technology?
Blockchain technology mein distributed ledger istemal karne ka aham faida kya hai?

options.text: Jaldi faislon ke liye centralized control
Transactions ki history aasani se badal sakna
Decentralized verification ki wajah se zyada transparency aur security
Ledger chalane ke liye kam computing power

blocks.explanation: Har node ke paas ledger ki copy hoti hai aur transactions ki jaanch kisi ek authority ki bajaye network karta hai (6.4.1.2), is liye sab ek hi record dekhte hain (transparency) aur chhed chhaar pakri jati hai (security).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 6) (b) deti hai. Magar history aasani se badalna blockchain ki immutability ke ulat hai: block jurne ke baad badla nahi ja sakta (6.4.1.1). Sahi faida (c) hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Which of the following is NOT a type of cloud service?
Neeche mein se kaunsi cloud service ki qism NAHI hai?
blocks.explanation: Chapter cloud services ki teen bari qismein batata hai: IaaS, PaaS aur SaaS (6.2.2). Blockchain as a Service in mein shamil nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 6) (b) deti hai. Magar PaaS khud cloud service ki teen bari qismon mein se hai (6.2.2.2), is liye woh jawab nahi ho sakta; chapter ke mutabiq jo qism nahi woh (d) BaaS hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Which cloud deployment model combines public and private cloud features?
Kaunsa cloud deployment model public aur private cloud dono ki khoobiyan milata hai?
blocks.explanation: Hybrid cloud public aur private cloud ko milati hai aur data aur applications dono ke darmiyan chal sakte hain (6.2.3.3), jaise rozmarra kaam public par aur naazuk data private par.

blocks.prompt:
7. In the context of blockchain, what is the purpose of using a distributed ledger?
Blockchain ke hawale se distributed ledger istemal karne ka maqsad kya hai?

options.text: Sirf ek central authority blockchain chalaye
Kai participants data ko mehfooz aur transparent (saaf, sab ke saamne) tareeqe se share aur verify kar sakein
Network chalane ke liye participants ki ginti kam karna
Data central authority ke siwa sab se chhupana

blocks.explanation: Ledger tamam nodes mein phaila hota hai ta ke sab ke paas ek hi maloomat ho aur sab transactions ki jaanch mein hissa lein (6.4.1.2); is se kai participants data mehfooz aur saaf tareeqe se share aur verify karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir ki answer key (Unit 6) (c) deti hai. Magar distributed ledger ka maqsad participants kam karna nahi; yeh har node ke paas hota hai ta ke sab data share aur verify karein (6.4.1.2). Sahi jawab (b) hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Which type of cloud service provides a platform allowing customers to develop, run, and manage applications without dealing with the underlying infrastructure?
Kaunsi cloud service aisa platform deti hai jis par customers infrastructure ki fikr ke baghair applications bana, chala aur sambhal sakein?
blocks.explanation: PaaS development aur deployment ka poora mahol deti hai (servers, storage, networking, middleware aur tools), is liye developers hardware aur software layers sambhale baghair sirf code par tawajjo dete hain (6.2.2.2), jaise Google App Engine.

blocks.prompt:
9. Which service model allows developers to build and deploy applications without managing servers?
Kaunsa service model developers ko servers manage kiye baghair applications banane aur deploy karne deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Serverless architecture mein developers servers sambhale baghair applications banate aur deploy karte hain; cloud provider resources khud deta hai (6.6.1.2), jaise AWS Lambda.

blocks.prompt:
10. What does Blockchain 2.0 introduce beyond basic cryptocurrency applications?
Blockchain 2.0 basic cryptocurrency se aage kya laata hai?
blocks.explanation: Blockchain 2.0 cryptocurrency se aage smart contracts, decentralized applications (dApps) aur behtar scalability laata hai (6.6.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
11. What is a primary advantage of serverless architectures?
Serverless architectures ka main faida kya hai?

options.text: Har waqt server sambhalne ki zaroorat

blocks.explanation: Serverless mein developers sirf utne resources ki payment karte hain jitne asal mein istemal hon aur apne servers nahi chalate (6.6.1.2), is liye kharcha bachta hai. Baqi options serverless ke ulat hain (yeh khud scale hota hai).

blocks.prompt:
12. How does integrating AI with blockchain benefit data management?
AI ko blockchain ke saath jorna data management ko kaise faida deta hai?

options.text: Data ki security aur transparency barhati hai
Faide ke baghair complexity barhata hai

blocks.explanation: AI aur blockchain ka mel data ki security aur transparency barhata hai: AI blockchain par rakhe data ka analysis karta hai aur blockchain use chhed chhaar se mehfooz rakhta hai (6.6.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
13. Which of the following best describes immutability in blockchain?
Blockchain mein immutability ko sab se achhi tarah kaunsa jawab batata hai?

options.text: Administrator ke ikhtiyar se records badal sakna
Data sirf khaas shartein poori hone par badal sakna
Blockchain mein jurne ke baad data ka na badal sakna
Zaroorat na rahe to data blockchain se hata sakna

blocks.explanation: Immutability ka matlab hai ke block blockchain mein jurne ke baad na badla ja sakta hai na mitaya ja sakta hai, is liye transactions ki history permanent aur chhed chhaar se mehfooz rehti hai (6.4.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
14. Which of the following is an example of edge computing in use?
Edge computing ke istemal ki misal kaunsi hai?
blocks.explanation: Autonomous vehicles mein sensors aur cameras ka data gari ke andar hi process hota hai, is liye gari sarak ki haalat par foran react karti hai (6.6.1.1). Baqi options central servers par chalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
15. What is one of the environmental concerns related to blockchain technology?
Blockchain technology se juri environmental (mahol ki) fikr kaunsi hai?
blocks.explanation: (Chapter se aage.) Proof of Work (6.4.1.1) wale blockchains, jaise Bitcoin, mein bohat se computers block jorne ke liye mushkil puzzle hal karte hain, jis mein bohat zyada bijli kharch hoti hai. Is liye zyada energy consumption mahol ke liye fikr ki baat hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Proof of Work ko aise samjho: naya block jorne ka haq usay milta hai jo sab se pehle ek bohat mushkil hisaab hal kare. Duniya bhar ke hazaron computers din raat yahi hisaab karte hain, aur un sab ki bijli milakar kai mulkon jitni ho jati hai. Proof of Stake jaise tareeqe is kharche ko bohat kam kar dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
16. What is the primary function of a Peer-to-Peer (P2P) network in blockchain technology?
Blockchain technology mein Peer-to-Peer (P2P) network ka main kaam kya hai?

options.text: Central authorities ko network ka control dena
Central server ke baghair nodes ke darmiyan seedha data share karna
Network mein encryption ki zaroorat kam karna

blocks.explanation: P2P network mein nodes central server ke baghair aapas mein seedha baat aur resources share karte hain, aur har node client aur server dono ka kaam karta hai (6.4.1.3).

blocks.prompt:
17. Which technology benefits from processing data at the "edge" of the network?
Kaunsi technology network ke "edge" (kinare) par data process karne se faida uthati hai?
blocks.explanation: Edge computing data ko network ke "edge" par, yaani data ke source ke qareeb, process karti hai, sirf central data centers par bharosa nahi karti (6.6.1.1).

blocks.prompt:
18. What is a smart contract in the context of Blockchain 2.0?
Blockchain 2.0 ke hawale se smart contract kya hai?

options.text: Khud chalne wala contract jis ki shartein seedhi code mein likhi hon
Teesre fareeq (third party) ka chalaya contract

blocks.explanation: Smart contract khud chalne wala (self-executing) contract hai jis ki shartein seedhi code mein likhi hoti hain; muqarrar shartein poori hone par yeh kisi beech wale (intermediary) ke baghair khud chal jata hai (6.6.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
1. Analyze the role of Peer-to-Peer Networks in Blockchain. How do they function and why are they essential?
Blockchain mein P2P networks ka role (kirdar): yeh kaise kaam karte aur kyun zaroori hain?
blocks.explanation:
Peer-to-peer (P2P) network aisa system hai jis mein computers (nodes) central server ke baghair aapas mein seedha baat aur resources share karte hain; har node client aur server dono ka kaam karta hai (6.4.1.3).
Blockchain mein kaise kaam karta hai:
- Har node ledger (blockchain) ki poori copy rakhta hai.
- Naye transactions aur blocks network mein ek node se doosre node tak seedhe jate hain.
- Nodes protocol ke rules se transactions aur blocks ki jaanch karte hain aur block jorne se pehle consensus (ittifaq) karte hain.
Kyun zaroori hai:
- Is se blockchain decentralized hota hai: koi ek banda ya computer malik nahi.
- Ek jagah kharabi se system nahi rukta: kuch nodes band hon to bhi network chalta hai.
- Bohat si copies hone se chhed chhaar foran pakri jati hai, jis se security aur transparency milti hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Describe the concept of immutability in blockchain. Why is it a critical feature?
Blockchain mein immutability (na badal sakna) ka concept bataiye; yeh kyun aham hai?
blocks.explanation:
Immutability: block blockchain mein jurne ke baad na badla ja sakta hai na mitaya ja sakta hai (6.4.1.1).
Yeh kaise hota hai:
- Har block apna hash (digital pehchan) aur pichhle block ka hash rakhta hai, is liye purana block badalne se chain ke rishte toot jate hain.
- Har node ke paas copy hai, is liye badli hui copy baqi se nahi milti aur radd ho jati hai.
- Data cryptography (khufia hisaab) se lock hota hai.
Kyun aham hai:
- Transactions ki history permanent aur chhed chhaar se mehfooz rehti hai, yaani bharose ka na badalne wala record.
- Kisi central authority ke baghair bharosa banta hai aur dhoka rukta hai, jaise paison ki transfer, certificates aur supply chain ke records mein.

blocks.prompt:
3. What is edge computing and how does it benefit data processing?
Edge computing kya hai aur data processing ko kaise faida deti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Edge computing processing ko data ke source ke qareeb le aati hai: data sirf central data centers mein nahi, balke network ke "edge" (kinare) par, jahan woh banta hai, process hota hai (6.6.1.1).
Data processing ke faide:
- Latency (der) kam, kyunke data ko door safar nahi karna parta.
- Jaldi faisle aur real-time (usi waqt) processing.
- Zyada efficiency (network par kam data jata hai).
Misal: autonomous vehicles mein sensors aur cameras ka data gari ke andar hi process hota hai ta ke foran react kare. Smart cities, healthcare monitoring aur industrial automation mein bhi faidemand.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the concept of serverless architectures.
Serverless architectures ka concept (khayal) bataiye.
blocks.explanation:
Serverless architecture developers ko servers sambhale baghair applications banane aur deploy karne deti hai (6.6.1.2).
- Servers hote hain, magar unhein cloud provider chalata aur sambhalta hai aur zaroorat ke mutabiq resources khud deta hai.
- Developer sirf code likh kar deta hai; zaroorat par woh chal jata hai.
- Application demand ke saath khud scale (chhoti bari) hoti hai.
- Sirf asal istemal hone wale resources ki payment hoti hai.
Misal: AWS Lambda servers banaye ya sambhale baghair code chalata hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. What are smart contracts in Blockchain 2.0?
Blockchain 2.0 mein smart contracts kya hain?
blocks.explanation:
Smart contracts khud chalne wale (self-executing) contracts hain jin ki shartein seedhi code mein likhi hoti hain aur blockchain par chalte hain (6.6.2.1, 6.4.3.2).
- Muqarrar shartein poori hote hi yeh khud chal kar shartein laagu karte hain.
- Beech wale (intermediaries) ki zaroorat khatam aur ghalti aur dhoke ka khatra kam.
- Sab shartein dekh sakte hain (transparency) aur blockchain chalne ki zamanat deta hai (security).
Misalein: jaidad mein payment aur malkiyat ki jaanch poori hote hi malkiyat khareedar ko aur paise bechne wale ko chale jate hain; flight late ho to insurance contract khud paise de deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. How does integrating blockchain with IoT improve supply chain management?
Blockchain ko IoT se jorna supply chain management kaise behtar karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
IoT devices (sensors) khud data record karte hain, aur blockchain use mehfooz, saaf aur chhed chhaar se mehfooz ledger mein rakhta hai (6.6.2.2, 6.5.1).
- Sensors supplier se customer tak har stage par maal ki jagah, temperature aur waqt record karte hain.
- Har record blockchain mein jurta hai aur badal nahi sakta, is liye maal ka safar trace (peecha) kiya ja sakta hai aur bharose ke qabil hai.
- Chain ke sab log ek hi data dekhte hain, is liye maal asli hai ya nahi aur us ka meyar jaancha ja sakta hai.
- Masle ki jarr jaldi milti hai, aur dhoka aur ghaltiyan kam hoti hain.
- AI ke saath yahi data demand ka andaza lagane aur logistics behtar karne mein kaam aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. What advantages do serverless architectures offer to developers?
Serverless architectures developers ko kya faide deti hain?
blocks.explanation:
Serverless architectures ke developers ke liye faide (6.6.1.2):
- Server sambhalne se chhutkara: servers set up, update ya maintain nahi karne parte.
- Code par tawajjo: developers infrastructure ki bajaye code aur features par waqt lagate hain.
- Automatic scaling: application demand ke saath khud barhti ghatti hai.
- Kharche ki bachat: sirf asal istemal ki payment.
- Kam operational complexity (chalane ki pechidgi) aur jaldi development aur deployment.
Misal: AWS Lambda.

blocks.prompt:
8. How does edge computing improve the efficiency of autonomous vehicles?
Edge computing autonomous vehicles (khud chalne wali gariyon) ki efficiency kaise barhati hai?
blocks.explanation:
Autonomous gari ko sarak par pal bhar mein react karna hota hai. Edge computing ke saath (6.6.1.1):
- Sensors aur cameras ka data door ke data center ki bajaye gari ke andar hi process hota hai.
- Latency kam hoti hai, is liye faisle (brake, mor, rukawat se bachna) usi waqt hote hain.
- Gari sarak ki badalti haalat par foran react karti hai, jis se hifazat barhti hai.
- Network par kam data jata hai, aur kamzor connection mein bhi gari kaam karti rehti hai (aam maloomat).

blocks.prompt:
9. Differentiate between Elasticity and On-Demand access in cloud computing.
Cloud computing mein elasticity aur on-demand access mein farq bataiye.
blocks.explanation:
(6.2.1.2, 6.2.1.3)
- Matlab: on-demand access ka matlab hai jab zaroorat ho foran resources le kar istemal karna, lambe setup ke baghair. Elasticity ka matlab hai demand ke mutabiq resources ka khud barhna ya ghatna.
- Kaun karta hai: on-demand mein user khud resource maangta hai; elasticity mein system khud adjust karta hai.
- Tawajjo: on-demand foran resource milne par; elasticity demand badalne par performance, efficiency (aur kharcha) theek rakhne par.
- Misal: on-demand: school project ke liye foran mazeed storage kiraye par lena. Elasticity: Eid sale mein online store ke servers khud barhna aur sale ke baad kam ho jana.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: On-demand ko nalka samjho: jab chaho kholo aur pani lo (aap ne khud maanga). Elasticity aisi tanki hai jo khud dekhti hai ke kitna pani chahiye: zyada log aayein to khud zyada pani deti hai, kam hon to kam, aur aap ko kuch nahi karna parta.

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain the structure of a distributed ledger and evaluate the rationale behind its decentralization.
Distributed ledger ki structure (banawat) samjhaiye aur us ke decentralization ki wajah ko parakhiye.
blocks.explanation:
Distributed ledger tamam transactions ka digital record hai jo network ke sab nodes ke paas copy ho kar share hota hai, ta ke sab ke paas ek hi maloomat ho (6.4.1.2).
Structure:
1. Transactions: har transaction ek entry hai jo participants ke darmiyan asset ya maloomat ki transfer record karti hai.
2. Blocks: transactions blocks mein ikatthi hoti hain. Har block mein us ka apna hash (khaas pehchan), pichhle block ka hawala (parent hash), transactions ki list aur timestamp (waqt) hota hai (Figure 6.2).
3. Chain: har block pichhle block ki taraf ishara karta hai, is liye blocks tarteeb se chain bana lete hain, pehle block (Block 0) tak.
4. Nodes: peer-to-peer network ka har computer (node) chain ki poori copy rakhta hai aur transactions aur blocks ki jaanch mein madad karta hai.
5. Protocol aur consensus: blockchain protocol jaanch aur block jorne ke rules tay karta hai; Proof of Work aur Proof of Stake jaise consensus (ittifaq) ke tareeqon se nodes naya block jorne se pehle mutafiq hote hain.
Decentralization ki wajah (parakh):
- Central authority ki zaroorat nahi: bharosa kisi ek bank ya company ki bajaye network ke ittifaq se aata hai.
- Ek jagah kharabi se system nahi rukta: kuch nodes kharab hon ya un par hamla ho to baqi ledger chalate rehte hain, is se security barhti hai.
- Chhed chhaar mushkil: record badalne ke liye zyada tar copies badalni parengi aur hash ke rishte tootenge, is liye dhoka foran pakra jata hai (immutability).
- Transparency aur insaaf: sab ek hi record dekhte hain, aur tabdeeli sirf majority ke ittifaq se hoti hai.
- Kamzoriyan: bohat si copies aur consensus ke liye zyada computing power aur bijli chahiye aur yeh central database se dheema ho sakta hai; magar paise, contracts, voting aur supply chain mein security aur bharosa is kharche ke qabil hai.
Nateeja: decentralization ledger ko kisi ek par bharosa kiye baghair mehfooz, saaf aur qabil-e-bharosa banata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Doston ke us notebook ko yaad karo jis ki copy sab ke paas hai (6.4.1). Agar ek dost chupke se apni copy mein likh de ke us ne paise wapas kar diye, to baqi sab ki copies mein yeh nahi likha, is liye jhoot foran pakra jata hai. Koi ek "munshi" nahi jis par sab ko bharosa karna pare; sab mil kar record sahi rakhte hain. Yahi decentralization ka faida hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Define cloud deployment models and assess the differences among them.
Cloud deployment models ki tareef kijiye aur un ke farq ko parakhiye.
blocks.explanation:
Cloud deployment models batate hain ke cloud services kaise milti aur istemal hoti hain; har ek control, security aur flexibility (lachak) ka alag darja deta hai (6.2.3). Bare models: public, private, hybrid aur multi-cloud.
1. Public cloud (6.2.3.1)
- Internet par milti hai aur kai organizations mein share hoti hai; third-party (bahar ki company) provider chalata hai.
- Misal: Amazon Web Services (AWS).
2. Private cloud (6.2.3.2)
- Sirf ek organization istemal karti hai; apni jagah par ya third party ke paas, magar share nahi hoti.
- Misal: bank ki private cloud naazuk customer data ke liye.
3. Hybrid cloud (6.2.3.3)
- Public aur private ka mel; data aur applications dono ke darmiyan ja sakte hain.
- Misal: rozmarra kaam public par, naazuk data private par, aur rush ke dino mein zyada load public par.
4. Multi-cloud (6.2.3.4)
- Kai alag providers ki cloud services, ta ke ek par mohtaji na ho.
- Misal: analytics ke liye Google Cloud, karobari apps ke liye Microsoft Azure aur backup ke liye AWS.
Farq ki parakh (6.2.4):
- Istemal karne wale: public = kai organizations; private = ek organization; hybrid = ek organization dono ke saath; multi-cloud = ek organization kai providers ke saath.
- Kharcha: public sab se sasti; private mehngi; hybrid aur multi-cloud istemal ke hisaab se beech mein.
- Security aur control: private mein sab se zyada; public mein sab se kam; hybrid zaroori data private rakhti hai.
- Khoobi: public = kam kharcha; private = security; hybrid = flexibility; multi-cloud = resilience (mazbooti) aur reliability (ek provider band ho to doosre chalte rehte hain).
Chunao zaroorat par hai: chhota karobar public, bank private ya hybrid, aur bari company multi-cloud chun sakti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Rehaish ki misal: public cloud hostel jaisa hai (sab ke saath share, sasta). Private cloud apna ghar hai (mehnga magar poora control). Hybrid aisa hai ke qeemti saman ghar mein aur baqi cheezein kiraye ke store mein. Multi-cloud aisa hai ke alag kaamon ke liye alag dukanon se kharidari, ta ke ek dukaan band ho to kaam na ruke.

blocks.prompt:
3. Classify the various types of cloud services and compare them, highlighting key distinctions.
Cloud services ki qismein bata kar un ka comparison (saath rakh kar farq dekhna) kijiye, aur aham farq wazeh kijiye.
blocks.explanation:
Cloud services teen bari qismon mein baanti jati hain; har ek mein control, flexibility aur management ka darja alag hai (6.2.2).
1. Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) (6.2.2.1)
- Bunyadi computing infrastructure deta hai: servers, storage aur networking, jitna istemal utni payment (pay-as-you-go).
- User operating system, applications aur storage sambhalta hai, magar physical hardware nahi.
- Misalein: Amazon Web Services (virtual servers kiraye par), Microsoft Azure, Google Compute Engine.
2. Platform as a Service (PaaS) (6.2.2.2)
- Development aur deployment ka poora mahol: infrastructure ke saath middleware, development tools aur management services.
- Developers hardware aur software layers sambhale baghair sirf code likhte aur deploy karte hain.
- Misalein: Google App Engine, Microsoft Azure App Services, Heroku.
3. Software as a Service (SaaS) (6.2.2.3)
- Tayyar software jo provider chalata aur sambhalta hai; user subscription le kar internet par istemal karta hai.
- User ko na hardware sambhalna na updates karne.
- Misalein: Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Docs, Google Drive), Microsoft Office 365, Salesforce.
Comparison / aham farq:
- Kya milta hai: IaaS = khaam infrastructure; PaaS = app banane ka platform; SaaS = mukammal app.
- Kaun kya sambhalta hai: IaaS mein user OS, apps aur data; PaaS mein sirf apps aur data; SaaS mein sab kuch provider.
- Control aur flexibility: IaaS mein sab se zyada, PaaS mein darmiyana, SaaS mein sab se kam.
- Aasani: IaaS mein sab se kam, SaaS mein sab se zyada.
- Aam users: IaaS = IT administrators; PaaS = developers; SaaS = aam istemal karne wale (end-users).
Teeno ki payment istemal ya subscription ke hisaab se hoti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Khane ki misal se yaad rakho: IaaS aisa hai jaise kitchen kiraye par lena (khana khud pakao). PaaS aisa hai jaise kitchen ke saath saman aur bartan bhi mil jayein (sirf recipe par dhyan do). SaaS aisa hai jaise restaurant se pakka khana mangwana (bas khao). Jitna neeche jao, control kam aur aasani zyada.

blocks.prompt:
4. Discuss the advancements and benefits of edge computing in modern technology.
Modern technology mein edge computing ki tarraqi aur faide bataiye.
blocks.explanation:
Edge computing cloud computing ki aisi tarraqi hai jo processing ko data ke source ke qareeb le aati hai. Sara data central data centers bhejne ki bajaye data network ke "edge" (kinare) par, jahan woh banta hai, process hota hai (6.6.1.1).
Tarraqi:
- Processing door ke data centers se data ke qareeb devices aur local systems (gariyan, sensors, machines) par aa gayi hai.
- Yeh cloud ke saath mil kar kaam karti hai: fori kaam edge par, aur storage aur bara analysis cloud par.
Faide:
1. Kam latency (der): data kam faasla tay karta hai, is liye jawab jaldi milta hai.
2. Real-time processing aur jaldi faisle.
3. Zyada efficiency: network par kam data bhejna parta hai (bandwidth bachti hai).
4. Jahan pal bhar ka faisla zaroori ho wahan zyada hifazat.
Modern technology mein istemal:
- Autonomous vehicles: sensors aur cameras ka data gari mein hi process ho kar sarak ki haalat par foran react.
- Smart cities: maslan traffic signals jo live traffic ke mutabiq badlein.
- Healthcare monitoring: mareez ka data device par hi foran jaancha jaye.
- Industrial automation: machines usi jagah masla pakar kar theek karein.
Nateeja: edge computing, serverless architectures ke saath, cloud computing ko tez, zyada efficient aur scalable bana rahi hai (6.6).

blocks.prompt:
5. Explain the concept of serverless architectures and their impact on application development.
Serverless architectures ka concept aur application development par un ka asar samjhaiye.
blocks.explanation:
Concept: serverless architectures developers ko servers sambhale baghair applications banane aur deploy karne deti hain (6.6.1.2). Servers hote hain, magar unhein cloud provider chalata hai aur zaroorat ke mutabiq resources khud deta hai; developers sirf asal istemal ki payment karte hain.
Kaise kaam karta hai:
- Developer code (aam taur par chhote functions) likh kar provider ko deta hai.
- Provider zaroorat par code chalata hai aur resources khud barhata ghatata hai.
- Misal: AWS Lambda servers banaye ya sambhale baghair code chalata hai.
Application development par asar:
1. Code par tawajjo: developers infrastructure ki bajaye code aur features par waqt lagate hain.
2. Kam operational complexity (chalane ki pechidgi): servers install, update ya maintain nahi karne parte.
3. Automatic scalability: app chand users se le kar bohat zyada users tak khud scale hoti hai.
4. Kharche ki bachat: sirf istemal hone wale resources ki payment, khali khare servers ki nahi.
5. Tez development: apps jaldi bante, test aur deploy hote hain.
Nateeja: serverless architectures cloud par app banana aasan, sasta aur zyada scalable banati hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: "Serverless" ka matlab yeh nahi ke server hota hi nahi. Matlab yeh hai ke server ki fikr aap ki nahi. Jaise taxi (ride) lena: gari hai, driver hai, petrol hai, magar aap sirf safar ke paise dete hain; gari ki marammat aap ka kaam nahi.

blocks.prompt:
6. Describe Blockchain 2.0 and its advanced features.
Blockchain 2.0 aur us ki advanced features bataiye.
blocks.explanation:
Blockchain 2.0 blockchain technology ki woh nayi tarraqiyan hain jo basic cryptocurrency se aage advanced features aur salahiyatein laati hain (6.6.2.1). Blockchain 1.0 zyada tar digital paisa tha (jaise Bitcoin); Blockchain 2.0 blockchain par programs chalata hai.
Advanced features:
1. Smart contracts
- Khud chalne wale contracts jin ki shartein seedhi code mein likhi hoti hain.
- Muqarrar shartein poori hote hi khud chal kar shartein laagu karte hain, beech wale (intermediaries) ki zaroorat kam karte hain.
- Misal: jaidad mein payment aur malkiyat ki jaanch poori hote hi contract khud malkiyat khareedar ko aur paise bechne wale ko de deta hai. Flight late ho to insurance contract khud paise de sakta hai (6.4.3.2).
2. Decentralized applications (dApps)
- Aisi applications jo kisi ek company ke server ki bajaye blockchain network par chalti hain; Ethereum jaise platforms smart contracts se inhein banane dete hain.
3. Enhanced scalability
- Zyada transactions aur users ko achhi tarah sambhalne ki salahiyat.
Faide: transparency (sab contract ki shartein dekh sakte hain), security (blockchain chalne ki zamanat deta hai), aur kam ghaltiyan aur kam dhoka.
Istemal: finance, supply chain management, real estate aur insurance.
Mushkilat: smart contract ka code bilkul ghalti se paak hona chahiye, aur jhagron ke liye qanooni nizam zaroori hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Smart contract ko vending machine samjho: sahi paise dalo aur button dabao, to machine khud cheez de deti hai; kisi dukandar ki zaroorat nahi. Shart (paise poore) poori hui, kaam (cheez dena) khud ho gaya. Blockchain 2.0 yahi "khud chalne wale qaide" paison se aage jaidad, insurance aur doosre kaamon tak le aaya.

blocks.prompt:
7. How does integrating blockchain with AI and IoT create new opportunities and synergies?
Blockchain ko AI aur IoT se jorna naye mauqe aur synergies (mil kar zyada faida) kaise banata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Blockchain ko AI aur IoT jaisi nayi technologies se joda ja raha hai. Har technology doosri ki kamzori poori karti hai, jis se synergies (mil kar har ek se zyada faida) aur nayi ijaad ke mauqe bante hain (6.6.2.2).
1. AI aur blockchain
- Blockchain data ko mehfooz, saaf aur chhed chhaar se mehfooz rakhta hai; AI is bharose wale data ka analysis kar ke kaam ki baatein nikalta hai.
- Mil kar data ki security aur transparency barhate hain, data ki sehat (integrity) pakki karte hain aur privacy kharab kiye baghair insights dete hain.
- Misal: supply chain mein AI blockchain ke mehfooz data se demand ka andaza aur logistics behtar karta hai, jis se supply chain tez aur qabil-e-bharosa hoti hai.
2. IoT aur blockchain
- IoT devices (sensors, smart machines) data jama karte hain; blockchain use record karne ke liye decentralized aur chhed chhaar se mehfooz ledger deta hai.
- Is se devices ke darmiyan data ka len den mehfooz aur saaf hota hai aur bharosa aur security barhti hai.
- Misal: kheti (agriculture) mein IoT sensors mitti aur fasal ki sehat dekhte hain aur data blockchain par record hota hai; asli data se kisan behtar faisle kar ke paidawar barhate hain.
3. AI, IoT aur blockchain ikatthe
- IoT data jama karta hai, blockchain use mehfooz karta hai, aur AI use andazon aur khud-kaar faislon mein badalta hai (phir smart contracts un par amal kar sakte hain).
- Mauqe: supplier se customer tak maal ke asal ka peecha, smart kheti, healthcare records, smart cities aur certificates ki mehfooz tasdeeq.
Nateeja: yeh mel blockchain ke istemal ko cryptocurrency se aage barhata hai aur sab technologies ki salahiyat barhata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Teen dost socho: IoT "aankhein" hai (dekhta aur data jama karta hai), blockchain "tijori" hai (data ko mehfooz aur sach rakhti hai), aur AI "dimagh" hai (data se faisla karta hai). Akele har ek adhoora hai; teeno mil kar khet, factory ya dukaan ko khud samajhdar bana dete hain. Isi ko synergy kehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
8. Describe “Cloud Deployment Models” with examples.
“Cloud Deployment Models” misalon ke saath bataiye.
blocks.explanation:
Cloud deployment models batate hain ke cloud services kaise milti aur istemal hoti hain. Har model control, security aur flexibility ka alag darja deta hai (6.2.3).
1. Public cloud
- Internet par milne wali cloud service jo kai organizations mein share hoti hai aur third-party cloud provider chalata hai.
- Misal: Amazon Web Services (AWS); har size ke karobar physical hardware sambhale baghair is se virtual servers aur storage lete hain.
- Sasti magar kam mehfooz.
2. Private cloud
- Sirf ek organization ki cloud, apni jagah ya third party ke paas, kisi aur ke saath share nahi.
- Misal: bara bank apne data center mein private cloud rakh kar naazuk customer data mehfooz sambhalta hai.
- Zyada mehfooz magar mehngi.
3. Hybrid cloud
- Public aur private cloud ka mel; data aur applications dono mein share ho sakte hain.
- Misal: company rozmarra kaam public cloud par aur naazuk data private cloud par rakhti hai; rush ke dino mein kam naazuk kaam public par bhej deti hai.
- Flexibility aur control dono.
4. Multi-cloud
- Kai providers ki cloud services, ta ke ek provider par mohtaji na ho.
- Misal: data analytics ke liye Google Cloud Platform, karobari apps ke liye Microsoft Azure aur backup aur disaster recovery ke liye AWS.
- Resilience (mazbooti): ek provider mein masla ho to baqi chalte rehte hain.
(Community cloud, jo ek jaisi zarooraton wale organizations mil kar istemal karte hain, ek aur model hai; chapter mein is ki tafseel nahi.)
